_source: Gui.vb (statOffsetX/Y, statWidth 96 x statHeight 48, iFPSProfileSpeed 100, initFont; updateClock's m:ss at 300, 5 in yellow fontClock), Engine.vb renderDisplay and oneFrameRender's pause, Root.vb (colorReticle = Red; bDrawFPS True at the start and in every Reset). Positions are pixels of the original's 512 x 448 window (Form1.vb; the pause banner sits at 512 / 2, 448 / 2), y down; colours are Write's [alpha, red, green, blue]; fontSize is points (fontMenu Arial 10 bold, fontPause Arial Narrow 24, fontClock Arial Narrow 16). anchor is TopLeft, TopRight (x pixels in from the right edge: rTarget.Width - 50) or Center.

menu._source: Gui.vb loadMenu/renderMenu: menu.jpg on a menuWidth x menuHeight (255 x 255) quad at (10, 10), drawn while bMenu (Tab) and not paused; each line written in fontMenu (Arial 10 bold) with Write's 255, 255, 255, 64 at its own (x, y). lines are keyed by what the line's key does (F1 Wireframe, F2 Textures, F3 Culling, F4 Fps, F12 Video, ESC Quit).

loading._source: Form1.vb Startup (UNI-T58): n = getRndNum(1, 12) (Root.vb: rndNum.Next(1, 12 + 1), a Random seeded from the clock), then Me.BackgroundImage = gfx/gui/load/load640_<n>.jpg on the 640 x 480 form while the Engine is built, cleared (Me.BackgroundImage = Nothing) just before the first oneFrameRender. pictures is how many load640_<n> there are, numbered from 1.

zone._source: Zone.vb loadZone/renderZone (UNI-T56), Textures.vb texZone (gfx/gui/event.png, a 2 x 2 of 0, 128, 255), Root.vb bZone = True, Form1.vb's E (bZone = Not bZone). Screen units, y up (space.json maps them). loadZone's box runs left..right and bottom..top from its corner; renderZone moves one to each enemy, its corner at Enemy(n).X + enemySize / 2, Enemy(n).Y (the enemy quad's centre: enemyCorner, from the centre), and one to the mace, its corner at rectMace.Left, rectMace.Top (link(Mace).X + 0.01, link(Mace).Y + maceSize / 2; the 3.5 x linkSize mace quad's centre is link(Mace).X + 0.04375, so maceCorner is [0.01 - 0.04375, 0.075 / 2] from the centre). Root.vb's Reset never touches bZone.

port._about: Not in the original, whose D3D line strip is one pixel wide: the line's width in world units, never mapped.
Not in the original: the dim behind the pause banner, the game-over banner over the fade, and a thin drop shadow under the HUD text.
